scope_note: COMPARATOR ROW. Filed at advanced_packaging, NOT hbm: the sentence that names CPM1080's own demand driver says 'generative AI', not HBM -- HBM is named one sentence earlier only as part of the general market backdrop ('server-related investments, such as High Bandwidth Memory (HBM)'), and TOWA never states that CPM1080 itself serves HBM, MUF, 2.5D/3D or fan-out. Upgrading 'generative AI' to 'HBM' here would be exactly the kind of inference the intake brief warns against. This is a production/order-volume claim (record order and sales for the full fiscal year), not a technical capability or qualification claim; no customer, unit count or yen value is attached to CPM1080 specifically. The sentence also bundles 'molds' (tooling) together with 'compression equipment' in one order/sales figure, which is preserved verbatim rather than parsed apart.
